product_metadata.title: iDesign Classico Metal Tie Hanger, Hanging Closet Organization Storage Holder for Belts, Men's Ties, Women's Shawls, Pashminas, Scarves, Clothing, Accessories, Horizontal Rack
features: FUNCTIONAL ACCESSORY HANGER: Hanging closet organizer hanger features 7 straight hooks and 7 curved hooks perfect for hanging belts, ties, jewelry, shawls, pashminas, handbags, socks, delicates, outerwear, and more! Great for bedroom closet, hall closet, bathroom, and garage storage. Organizer hangs from one top hook on your closet rod
EASY INSTALLATION: No hardware required - simply hang over closet rod or hook!
DURABLE METAL: Reinforced hooks made of long-lasting steel for years of quality use
STYLISH: Shiny chrome finish looks great with any décor style
IDEAL SIZE: Hanging organizer measures 10.25" x 3.75" x 6.75", a compact size for any space
description: "The iDesign Classico 14 Hook Hanger helps keep belts, ties, and more organized and easy to find! This metal closet organizer requires no assembly - simply put your favorite accessories on the hooks and hang over any closet rod. Made of durable steel with a chrome finish, this hanger includes 7 straight hooks and 7 curved hooks loops to store scarves, ties, handbags, belts, clothing, and more. Keep your accessories organized while also maximizing your closet space! Hanging rack measures 10.25"" x 3.75"" x 6.75"", the perfect size for your closet. Set of two for use throughout your home.
With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day."
